title: Comparison of Dirichlet forms for stable-like random walks on groups of polynomial volume growth
summary: In earlier works, we studied natural examples of stable-like random walks on finitely generated nilpotent groups and, more generally, on groups of polynomial volume growth. These walks are driven by measures of radial type, coordinate-wise type, or convex combinations of such measures. In the present work, we explore when two such random walks have comparable behavior, as measured by the equivalence of their associated Dirichlet forms. We develop criteria for this equivalence in terms of both geometric and algebraic features of the driving measures and the group.
